name: Stone Is Better than Cloth
summary: In the Badlands, Lucien Tosselwrench has a gift for you, though his work is not finished. The extra stones you gathered are ready, but he still needs patterned bronze bracers.

sections.title: A Thank-You for Your Trouble
sections.body: After your work for Lotwil on his third Study of the Elements: Rock request, Lucien Tosselwrench admits Lotwil can be cheap. He means to make it up to you with fine enchanted bracers fashioned from the extra stones you gathered. They may help guard you against the coming atrocity of Lotwil's newest invention.

sections.title: What Lucien Needs
sections.body: To finish the bracers, Lucien needs patterned bronze bracers of the kind a blacksmith makes. He warns you not to wait long. No one knows what happens next.

faq.q: Who offers to craft the bracers?
aliases: who gives stone is better than cloth
faq.answer: Lucien Tosselwrench offers to make enchanted bracers from your extra stones in the Badlands.

faq.q: Why is Lucien making this armor for you?
faq.answer: Lucien knows Lotwil can be cheap and wants to repay you for your trouble. He says the bracers may also guard you against Lotwil's newest invention.

faq.q: What does Lucien need to finish crafting the bracers?
faq.answer: Lucien needs patterned bronze bracers, the kind a blacksmith makes, to finish the enchanted bracers.

aliases: prerequisite for stone is better than cloth
faq.answer: It follows your work on Lotwil's third Study of the Elements: Rock request.

angles.text: As a blacksmith, you can make the bronze bracers Lucien needs.
